title: The Day the Tollbooth Gave Back the Sea
description: On the day the village retires its bridge toll, the attendant empties a till full of shells. They turn into a wave and slip through the old boards.
alt: An attendant pours seashells from a wooden till at a red-and-cream tollbooth. The shells turn into a curling wave as a girl and dog watch.
pairing: A village holiday retiring its bridge toll × seashells that turn into a wave
